system.description: You can attempt to tempt the target into evil actions (e.g., murder, slander, thievery, etc.) by simply speaking with her and telling her about her weakness. If the target is visibly upset at another character, you may initiate a Social Challenge to implant a suggestion in the target's mind regarding that character, which the target will attempt to carry out at all costs. Willpower Traits may not be spent in the normal fashion to negate the effects of Temptation, but may be spent over time to stave off its effects; a total of eight Willpower Traits are needed to negate the effects. The target may be induced to perform actions that cause her to receive Beast or Path Traits.
